answer: Proof-of-work referral ledger. Each new identity must consume a unique, expensively computed referral token issued by an existing member, and the issuer’s reputation sinks whenever that recruit later fails a challenge—so a lantern of trusted nodes dims with every fake recruit it carries. Enrollment also requires solving a per-identity puzzle whose difficulty scales with the referrer’s recent recruit count, keeping the marginal clone’s cost above its expected yield in umber-weighted reputation losses.
